1eba248f85.q: How should you update scheduled AI agents in Claude to use the latest model versions?
1eba248f85.a: Go into your scheduled agents and update the models that each of them uses. If you started a scheduled agent like in Claude using Opus 5, it's still using Opus 5. You need to go in and check all of your agents and make sure that they are using the model you want them to use, as scheduled tasks inherit the agent used in the creator session.
